prompt_en: Create a photographic scene governed by a single dominant impossible relationship. Ordinary reality is visibly transformed around a subject inhabiting this altered reality: a woman at the edge of an empty seaside railway platform at blue hour. The sea has risen into an immense vertical plane of water that fills most of the frame, meeting the ordinary horizontal sea along one clear ninety-degree bend. This continuous transparent body of water cuts across the platform like a standing tide. The horizon, suspended water surface, and solid platform establish the impossible geometry immediately, while the photographic treatment makes the water feel physically present. Use the supplied portrait strictly as a visible facial-appearance and hair guide: preserve its face proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob curving toward the jaw, and fine separated bangs. Give her an unforced, absorbed presence. She wears a dark teal blouse with gently loose sleeves and simple charcoal trousers. Standing on the dry platform with her torso angled three quarters toward the camera, she reaches one hand sideways to touch the vertical water. Her arm belongs visibly to the near shoulder; the elbow is slightly bent and the fingertips meet the water plane at shoulder height. The touch produces a single circular ripple radiating across the vertical surface. Her other arm hangs naturally beside her body. Her face turns toward the point of contact, with a quiet look of discovery and soft lips, lending subtle human attraction to the enormous, uncanny encounter. Frame from just below her knees upward in a wide horizontal photograph. Place her face and contacting hand within the same clear focus plane, with enough separation to read the fingers, the water boundary, and the ripple simultaneously. The water sheet occupies roughly two thirds of the image and extends beyond its upper edge. Through it, the distant station canopy and horizon refract and shift; the nearby platform remains crisp and dry. Cool marine light passes through the water and illuminates her face, with a thin warm residual sunset rim on the bob. Use a natural perspective, tactile water texture, restrained cyan and charcoal color, and believable reflections. Let the vast continuous bend of the sea determine the image's first impression, with the person serving as an intimate scale reference and the fingertip ripple revealing a real contact with the impossible world.
